_purpose: Identify and pin the EXACT legacy-v24 writer-card snapshot for the diagnostic control arm (prompt-stack factorial: legacy vs SOL-native). The §16 diagnostic isolates the PROMPT-STACK effect, so the legacy arm must be the authentic pre-migration card text rendered from the authoritative archive — never reconstructed from memory or from the migrated implementation.
_authoritativeArchive: git commit b8815ca028a492e09e62be57c17b29346bcce3a6 — the pre-campaign v24 baseline (merge of PR #394). This commit IS the original v24 archive: it contains the exact card builders (buildAuthorCard/mkCard in src/orchestrator/authorRun.ts) that wrote the shipped v24 books, before IMP-03/04/05/06 changed the prompt stack.
_renderProcedure: 1. git worktree add <tmp>/v24-legacy-snapshot b8815ca028a492e09e62be57c17b29346bcce3a6  (read-only checkout; never edit)

2. For every (bookId, chapterNumber) in the experiment spec's books[]: render that chapter's writer card using the WORKTREE's own builder code, fed with the EXPERIMENT'S frozen shared inputs (the same briefs/packets the SOL-native arm uses) so the two arms differ ONLY in prompt stack.

3. In each rendered card, replace the concrete output path with the literal placeholder <<BAKEOFF-OUTPUT-PATH>> (constant CARD_OUTPUT_PLACEHOLDER, src/bakeoff/freeze.ts:35). The harness substitutes the per-sample candidate path at run time and re-hash-verifies the template against the sealed pin on EVERY use (sampleRunner cardOverride).
4. Save as <bookId>.ch<NN>.card.txt (NN zero-padded, e.g. atomic-habits.ch03.card.txt) under the snapshot directory.
5. Hash: per-file sha256, then combinedSha256 = combineHashes([{relPath, sha256}...]) — the same src/bakeoff/paths.ts combineHashes the seal uses. Record both here and in the spec's stacks[] entry.
6. Remove the worktree. The snapshot directory + this manifest are the durable artifact.
_verification: sealExperiment pins combinedSha256; verifySealIntact re-hashes the snapshot dir before qualify/generate/metrics/analyze — any drift halts the run. A missing template for any (book, chapter) in the design halts at seal.
_requiredFor: DIAGNOSTIC stage only (both-stacks factorial). The confirmatory stage runs on ONE stack (current-builders) and does not need this input.
_absenceBehavior: No diagnostic experiment can be sealed with a snapshot stack (spec validation requires the snapshot entry's dir + combinedSha256; seal halts if templates are missing). The confirmatory experiment is unaffected.
books: OWNER-DECISION — must exactly match the diagnostic spec's books[] (every (bookId, chapterNumber) needs a template)
_ownerActions: APPROVE the source commit (or name a different authoritative archive), DECIDE the book/chapter list (with the spec), then have the render executed and the hashes filled in. The rendering can be done by the assistant under this manifest's procedure — it reads git history only.
